decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's consumer health and pharmacy channel knowledge, so the firm can read market feedback and refine the line instead of withdrawing it.
The skin and hair supplement sits within the firm's established supplement expertise, and its prominent launch shows a commitment the firm can sustain through incremental improvement.
As an extension of the Trivital brand, the joint product draws on deep related knowledge in formulation, regulation and marketing, which makes it easy to keep and improve.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche with lower visibility, but post-pandemic immune demand and the firm's supplement know-how make keeping it reasonable.

The valsartan generic is distant from core knowledge and was damaged by the recall, but the firm's generics, quality-control and regulatory capabilities let it source clean active ingredient and keep a staple product, though the risk of withdrawal remains notable.

The OTC triptan is technically distant, but it fits the firm's pharmacy OTC channel and its in-house pharmaceutical development and regulatory competence, so the firm can absorb learning from early results.
